description: This file defines an abstract class 'Dimension' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing worksheet dimension properties such as visibility, outline level, collapsed state, and formatting index. It provides methods to get and set these attributes, serving as a base class for more specific worksheet dimensions.

classes.name: Dimension
classes.description: Abstract class that manages common properties of worksheet dimensions such as visibility, outline level, collapsed state, and formatting index.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the xfIndex property with an optional initial value.

methods.name: getVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the dimension is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the dimension.

methods.name: getOutlineLevel
methods.description: Returns the outline level of the dimension.

methods.name: setOutlineLevel
methods.description: Sets the outline level, which must be between 0 and 7.

methods.name: getCollapsed
methods.description: Returns whether the dimension is collapsed.

methods.name: setCollapsed
methods.description: Sets the collapsed state of the dimension.

methods.name: getXfIndex
methods.description: Returns the index to the cellXf format. Null indicates no explicit format.

methods.name: setXfIndex
methods.description: Sets the index to the cellXf format.
